description: Angular component for selecting and managing time intervals, including custom and predefined options, with form controls and validation.

classes.name: TimeintervalComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a time interval selector with validation, custom intervals, and form integration.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up interval bounds.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, updates interval value accordingly.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the current interval value and updates view.

methods.name: updateIntervalValue
methods.description: Updates internal interval value based on current model, bounds, and allowed intervals.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Sets the interval in the form, toggling between predefined and custom.

methods.name: setCustomInterval
methods.description: Converts interval to custom form fields.

methods.name: boundInterval
methods.description: Calculates and sets available intervals, ensuring current value is within bounds.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates the model value based on form inputs and propagates change.

methods.name: calculateIntervalMs
methods.description: Calculates total milliseconds from custom interval fields.

methods.name: onIntervalChange
methods.description: Handles change in interval selection, toggling between advanced/custom.

methods.name: onSecsChange
methods.description: Adjusts seconds field, handling overflow and underflow.

methods.name: onMinsChange
methods.description: Adjusts minutes field, handling overflow and underflow.

methods.name: onHoursChange
methods.description: Adjusts hours field, handling overflow and underflow.
